svg.title: Deepak Vishwakarma — Data Science and Machine Learning
svg.desc: Terminal-style profile banner for Deepak Vishwakarma: an ASCII portrait, MSc from the University of Hertfordshire, focused on computer vision, predictive modelling and exploratory data analysis with Python, pandas, scikit-learn and TensorFlow. Selected projects: pest detection, face-mask CNN, Instacart market basket analysis and KC house price prediction.
